certainty_scale.OBSERVADO: Directly verified via wire payloads, explicit provider attribution strings (`source`), official provider CDN URLs, or native provider IDs.
certainty_scale.INFERIDO: High-confidence structural correspondence with upstream API/library schemas, column enums, or mathematical transformations.
certainty_scale.DESCONOCIDO: Not observable from client bundle or passive read-only public responses (server-side private worker internals).

attribution_proofs: Every sampled football match-odds response (1528974, 1528978, 1492455, 1520970, 1551883, 1550951, 1640019) returns bookmaker={'id': 2, 'name': 'Marathonbet'} (integer id=2 is Marathonbet in API-Sports v3, selected because API-Sports sorts bookmakers by id ascending and id=2 is the first bookmaker with wide global coverage) plus ISO updated_at.

us_sports_nba_nfl_nhl_mlb.provider: ESPN Public Scoreboard Embedded Odds (site.api.espn.com/.../scoreboard -> competitions[0].odds)
attribution_proofs: Every sampled upcoming NBA (401909980, 401909981), NHL (2026020312, 2026020313, 2026020321), and NFL (401873053, 401873058) match-odds response returns bookmaker={'id': '100', 'name': 'DraftKings'} (string '100' is ESPN's provider.id for its official sportsbook partner DraftKings) and updated_at=null.

For NHL (which uses 10-digit NHL gameIds in public.games), match-odds resolves home/away team abbreviations and game date in Supabase and cross-matches ESPN's NHL scoreboard to obtain DraftKings odds at $0 cost.
